summary: Paysafe Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q2 2026 earnings press release. The filing reports revenue of $447.4 million, a 4% increase year-over-year, and an adjusted net income of $23.1 million. It also notes the refinancing of its revolver and term loans and resolution of a legacy legal matter. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special-situation transaction is announced. This is a routine earnings report, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
